3. Screenshot 3: Similar debug screen "Стр. 3402", with text "ВЫ ЗНАЛИ, ЧТО НАША ЛЮБОВЬ В паках больше выбора Теперь можно выбрать 1 карту из 4 предложенных"

Wait — this appears to be a smartphone browser reading manga, and the app is monitoring the screen. Interesting: the user says "это все в браузере при авточтении" — "this is all in the browser during auto-reading".

The issue seems to be: OCR text is being mixed up between pages. In screenshot 2, "Полный текст: ТБР" and region text "ТБР" — "TBP" is a signature watermark on the manga page (the scanlation team signature). The debug screen shows page 2282 detected 1 region with text "ТБР" (TBP watermark). In screenshot 3, the text includes the caption from the page plus the popup text "В паках больше выбора" (a browser/system popup notification about cards?), plus something garbled "ВЫЗНАЛИ, ЧТО НАША ЛЮБОВЬ В паках больше выбора". Actually in screenshot 1, the browser showed a toast/popup at the bottom "В паках больше выбора. Теперь можно выбрать 1 карту из 4 предложений" (+1).

# Yomikai ### Full-Featured Reader for Android Discover and read manga, webtoons, comics, and more – easier than ever on your Android device. [![Discord server](https://img.shields.io/discord/1464063546257182876.svg?label=&labelColor=6A7EC2&color=7389D8&logo=discord&logoColor=FFFFFF)](https://discord.com/invite/TXvTZdBuQa) [![GitHub downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/sj0404-collab/yomikai/total?label=downloads&labelColor=27303D&color=0D1117&logo=github&logoColor=FFFFFF&style=flat)](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/yomikai/releases) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/sj0404-collab/yomikai/build.yml?labelColor=27303D)](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/yomikai/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/github/license/mihonapp/mihon?labelColor=27303D&color=0877d2)](/LICENSE) ## Download [![Yomikai Stable](https://img.shields.io/github/release/sj0404-collab/yomikai.svg?maxAge=3600&label=Stable&labelColor=06599d&color=043b69)](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/yomikai/releases) *Requires Android 8.0 or higher.* New to Yomikai? Check out our [**Getting Started Guide**](https://github.com/sj0404-collab/yomikai#readme) to set up your library. ---
## Features Yomikai takes the features of Mihon and enhances them with advanced tools for language learners. | Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | 🔍 **Built-in Text Recognition** | Fast, on-device OCR to extract text from images in real-time. Online models are also available for more languages. | | 📖 **Yomitan Dictionary Support** | Seamless dictionary lookups for language learners across multiple languages. | | **One-click Anki Cards** | Instantly create flashcards while reading and looking up new words. | Core Reader Features: * Experimental offline panel-by-panel reading. * Local reading of content. * A configurable reader with multiple viewers, reading directions and other settings. * Tracker support: [MyAnimeList](https://myanimelist.net/), [AniList](https://anilist.co/), [Kitsu](https://kitsu.app/), [MangaUpdates](https://mangaupdates.com), [Shikimori](https://shikimori.one), [Bangumi](https://bgm.tv/) and [Hikka](https://hikka.io/) support. * Categories to organize your library. * Light and dark themes. * Schedule updating your library for new chapters. * Create backups locally to read offline or to your desired cloud service. * Plus much more... ## 🤝 Contributing Feature requests, bug reports, and pull requests are welcome. For major changes, please open an issue or join our [discord](https://discord.com/invite/TXvTZdBuQa) to discuss what you would like to change. 152:      *

154:      * одну озвученную реплику без прокрутки и без объяснения. Теперь при
155:      * выключенной службе чтение честно ждёт и говорит, что именно надо
156:      * включить, но ждёт не бесконечно: иначе кнопка «Стоп» пришлось бы искать
157:      * вслепую.
158:      *
159:      * @return false, если службу так и не включили либо чтение отменили
160:      */
161:     private suspend fun awaitGestureService(onNote: (String) -> Unit): Boolean {
162:         var waited = 0L
163:         // currentCoroutineContext(), а не isActive: здесь нет CoroutineScope,
164:         // и isActive без получателя просто не разрешается.
165:         while (currentCoroutineContext().isActive &&
166:             !OverlayGestureService.isEnabled() &&
167:             waited < GESTURE_WAIT_MAX_MS
168:         ) {
169:             if (waited == 0L) onNote("Включите Службу доступности — жду, чтобы листать")
170:             delay(GESTURE_WAIT_MS)
171:             waited += GESTURE_WAIT_MS
172:         }
173:         if (!OverlayGestureService.isEnabled()) {
174:             onNote("Без Службы доступности листать нечем — чтение остановлено")
175:             return false
176:         }
177:         return currentCoroutineContext().isActive
178:     }
179: 
180:     /**
181:      * Прокрутка вперёд с проверкой результата.
182:      *
183:      * Прежний код останавливал чтение на первом же отказе жеста, и читатель
184:      * слышал одну реплику — после неё не было ни прокрутки, ни объяснения.
185:      * Теперь отказ не завершает чтение: жест повторяется, а если и он не
186:      * прошёл, причина называется прямо.
187:      */
188:     private suspend fun scrollForward(region: Rect): Boolean {
189:         repeat(SCROLL_ATTEMPTS) {
190:             if (OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(verticalSwipe(region, scrollDistance))) return true
191:             delay(SCROLL_RETRY_MS)
192:         }
193:         // Жест уходит, но экран не меняется: значит точка не слушается.
194:         return scrollWithFallback(region)
195:     }
196: 
197:     /** Свайп у самого низа рамки и длиннее обычного — последний довод. */
198:     private suspend fun scrollWithFallback(region: Rect): Boolean {
199:         val dy = (region.height() * FALLBACK_STEP).toInt()
200:         if (dy < 1) return false
201:         val x = region.left + (region.width() * FALLBACK_X).toInt()
202:         return OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(
203:             fromX = x,
204:             fromY = region.bottom - (region.height() * 0.05f).toInt(),
205:             toX = x,
206:             toY = region.bottom - (region.height() * 0.05f).toInt() - dy,
207:             durationMs = FALLBACK_MS,
208:         )
209:     }
210: 
211:     /** Пара координат свайпа по центру области на долю [fraction] её высоты. */
212:     private fun verticalSwipe(region: Rect, fraction: Float): GestureSwipe {
213:         val dy = (region.height() * fraction).toInt()
214:         val cx = region.centerX()
215:         val cy = region.centerY()
216:         return GestureSwipe(cx, cy + dy, cx, cy - dy)
217:     }
218: 
219:     /**
220:      * Озвучивает и ждёт конца речи, затем паузу.
221:      *
222:      * `TtsSpeaker` не отдаёт «прочитано» промисом, но сообщает состояние
223:      * через колбэк: [onState] приходит false, когда речь закончилась.
224:      */
225:     private suspend fun speakAndWait(text: String) {
226:         val done = kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
227:         var started = false
228:         TtsSpeaker.speak(context, text) { speaking ->
229:             if (speaking) {
230:                 started = true
231:             } else if (started) {
232:                 done.complete(Unit)
233:             }
234:         }
235:         // Если движок не сообщил о начале (например, голос не найден),
236:         // ждать завершения бессмысленно — цикл обязан идти дальше.
237:         if (!started) {
238:             delay(NO_SPEECH_GRACE_MS)
239:             return
240:         }
241:         withTimeoutOrNull(MAX_SPEECH_MS) { done.await() }
242:         if (coroutineContext.isActive && pauseAfterSpeechMs > 0) delay(pauseAfterSpeechMs)
243:     }
244: 
245:     /**
246:      * Листать назад по одному экрану — кнопка «▲ назад» на панели.
247:      *
248:      * Работает и без запущенного цикла чтения: пригодится, чтобы вернуться к
249:      * предыдущей реплике вручную.
250:      */
251:     suspend fun scrollBack(region: Rect): Boolean {
252:         val dy = (region.height() * scrollDistance).toInt()
253:         if (dy < 1) return false
254:         val cx = region.centerX()
255:         val cy = region.centerY()
256:         return OverlayGestureService.swipeAndAwait(GestureSwipe(cx, cy - dy, cx, cy + dy))
257:     }
258: 
259:     companion object {
260:         private const val TAG = "OverlayAutoReader"
261:         private const val RETRY_DELAY_MS = 900L
262: 
263:         /** Сколько ждать, если движок вообще не начал говорить. */
264:         private const val NO_SPEECH_GRACE_MS = 300L
265: 
266:         /** Потолок одной реплики: иначе зависший движок стопорит цикл. */
267:         private const val MAX_SPEECH_MS = 5 * 60_000L
268: 
269:         /** Сколько одинаковых кадров подряд считаем «не пролисталось». */
270:         private const val MAX_REPEATS = 2
271: 
272:         /** Сколько раз повторить жест, прежде чем менять геометрию. */
273:         private const val SCROLL_ATTEMPTS = 2
274: 
275:         /** Пауза между попытками жеста, мс. */
276:         private const val SCROLL_RETRY_MS = 350L
277: 
278:         /** Как часто проверять, не включили ли Службу доступности, мс. */
279:         private const val GESTURE_WAIT_MS = 1_500L
280: 
281:         /** Сколько ждать включения Службы, прежде чем остановить чтение, мс. */
282:         private const val GESTURE_WAIT_MAX_MS = 90_000L
283: 
284:         /** Доля высоты области для запасного свайпа. */
285:         private const val FALLBACK_STEP = 0.7f
286: 
287:         /** Запасной свайп идёт левее центра: там меньше всего кнопок. */
288:         private const val FALLBACK_X = 0.35f
289: 
290:         /** Запасной свайп длиннее и медленнее — его замечают даже «вялые» списки. */
291:         private const val FALLBACK_MS = 480L
292:     }
293: }

The browser tab already has:
- `detectBookZone()` — finds the manga image zone
- `detectOverlayJunkRects()` — finds ad/popup/modal rects via DOM heuristics
- `blankJunkRects()` — blacks them out before OCR
- `cropToZone()` — crops to book zone

The user says the ad popup keeps changing ("все время меняется") and interferes with the dialogue and sound effects. They suggest using a Chrome adblock extension approach.

Let me continue reading BrowserTab to see the auto-read loop and WebViewClient setup, and how JS injection on page load works. Then I'll implement a proper ad-blocking content script injected into the WebView (like uBlock/AdGuard cosmetic filtering): a JS that runs on page load (DOMContentLoaded) and via a MutationObserver continuously removes/hides ad-like nodes (fixed overlays with high z-index in the lower part, iframes with ad src, elements matching ad classes/ids, and the specific "В паках больше выбора"-style cards) — blocking both visually and thus from the OCR frame, plus network-level blocking of known ad domains in shouldInterceptRequest.

Actually the user says "или как он там называется" — they're not sure about the name; they just want ad blocking in the browser tab. The most practical implementation for Android WebView:

1. **Network filter** (`WebViewClient.shouldInterceptRequest`): block requests to known ad/tracking domains from a built-in hosts-style list. This kills ad scripts before they run (prevents the popup from appearing at all, and prevents "тюк-тук" sounds).
2. **Cosmetic filter** (injected JS): remove ad elements that are already in the DOM, including site-injected "cards" like the one in the screenshot. Run on each page start and via MutationObserver on subtree to catch dynamically injected ads ("все время меняется").

Chrome extensions can't be installed into WebView, so we implement the extension's core functionality natively. That's the honest approach.

Let me continue reading BrowserTab (lines 460-1000) to see the rest of the auto-read loop and WebView setup, and where WebViewClient is created.

- `configureWebView` (line 482) — WebView settings + `webViewClient` (line 562) + `webChromeClient`. `onPageStarted` at 563, `onPageFinished` at 593 — where JS is injected (e.g., the `yk-noselect` style at line 603-607). No `shouldInterceptRequest` for ad blocking.

Plan for implementation — a real ad blocker for the in-app browser:

1. **New file: `BrowserAdBlock.kt`** in `eu.kanade.tachiyomi.ui.webbrowser`:
   - **Network filter**: a set of ad/tracking domains (a hosts-style list). Implement `WebResourceResponse shouldInterceptRequest` blocking: if host matches ad domain (exact or subdomain), return an empty `WebResourceResponse("text/plain", "utf-8", empty)` — kills ad scripts/iframes/beacons before they load (this is what stops the popup from being injected at all and its sounds).
   - **Cosmetic JS**: a content-script (string) injected on `onPageStarted` (document start, so it can catch early DOM) and via `onPageFinished`, with a MutationObserver that continuously hides/removes:
     - elements matching ad id/class patterns (adv, banner, promo, adsbygoogle, adb, telegram, ins)
     - fixed/sticky overlays with z-index ≥ 10 in the lower 75% of the viewport (the same heuristics as `detectOverlayJunkRects` but actually removing elements, not just blanking pixels)
     - the specific "card" popups like the screenshot one ("В паках больше выбора" — a fixed position card in bottom area) — generic: fixed/sticky elements near bottom that aren't reader chrome.

The user wants the popup gone from the browser itself ("мешает диалогу либо звуковым эффектам" — interferes with the dialogue/sound effects). So removing the elements from the page (and blocking their network requests) is right.

2. Since ads "всё время меняется" (keep changing), a MutationObserver-based continuous filter is the answer — like uBlock's "cosmetic filtering with dynamic re-checks".

3. Also **network-level blocking** of known ad domains prevents scripts from injecting the popups in the first place. Include a decent list of Russian ad networks since the site is mangabuff.ru etc. (they serve ads via own domain + adsterra/clickadu/etc. — hmm, adsterra-type ads are served from the site's own domain often). var KEEP = /(reader|reading|manga|chapter|page|swiper|slide|img|image|' +

That's actually invalid JS! You can't break a regex literal with string concatenation. The `/(...| image|' +` is a regex terminated? Let's see: `var KEEP = /(reader|...|image|/i` — the regex ends at the first `/` after "image|'"? Actually `/.../ ' + ' ... `/` — the first `/` after `image|'+` closes the regex, then `+` is parsed as... it's a syntax error indeed ("Invalid regular expression").

Wait, but the error says "missing /" at line 14 — because the regex `/(reader|...|image|image|` hmm. Actually: `/(reader|reading|manga|chapter|page|swiper|slide|img|image|` — no closing `/` before newline → regex literal continues to next line, and eventually finds `/` at `'/i`'s... whatever — it's broken.

```js
var KEEP = new RegExp('(reader|reading|manga|chapter|page|swiper|slide|img|image|' +
```

## 2. `cleanOcrGarbage` (2942–2996)

```kotlin
fun cleanOcrGarbage(text: String, language: String): String      // 2942
```

Pipeline, in order:

1. **2943–2945** split into rows, `OcrTextCleaner.stripPromotionalText(it).trim()`, drop blanks. (Strip removes reader watermarks/ads: `PROMOTIONAL_SITE` remanga/readmanga/mangabuff/…, `PROMOTIONAL_SLOGAN` "читай раньше всех", `PROMOTIONAL_ADBLOCK` "+ алмазы и промокоды…", standalone ad buttons — `OcrTextCleaner.kt:83–138`.)
2. **2948–2951** early return: a **single row that is one whole word, length 3..14, all letters** → returned as-is (short words are no longer chopped).
3. **2958–2961** `DIGIT_GLUE_RE` (`(?<=[\p{L}])[0-9]+|[0-9]+(?=[\p{L}])`) → digits **glued to letters** are replaced by " " (kills "4а", "eS la 4", "WX i"); standalone numbers are preserved on purpose. `WHITESPACE_RE` collapse.
4. **2963** `kept = rows.filter { isMeaningfulRow(row, language) }` — see §3.
5. **2964–2969** If everything was rejected but the source was long → return the row with the **most letters** if it has ≥4 letters, else `""`.
6. **2972–2984** Re-join kept rows: trailing `-` → glue without space (word hyphenation); `joinsWithLeadingWord` (3007–3021, v1.9.139) glues Cyrillic runs split *without* hyphen ("ЗДО-\nРОВЬЕ") only when the concatenation is a known dictionary word and at least one half isn't itself a word; otherwise insert a space.
7. **2985–2995** Post-process `REPEATED_CHAR_RE` (`(.)\1{2,}`): collapses 3+ repeated chars to a single char **only for `! ? . … ~`** ("!!!!" → "!", "......" → "…"); any other repeated char is left untouched. Whitespace collapse + trim.

### `isMeaningfulRow(row, language)` (3024–3068) — the per-row filter rules
- `letters == 0` → false (3028).
- `letters/length < 0.4 && length >= 3` → false (sticks/brackets/arrows rows).
- `letters <= 2` (3031–3043): only for **ru**; row must be a real 1–2-letter Russian word (`isShortRussianWord`, set `RUSSIAN_SINGLE_WORD` 2774 / `RUSSIAN_SHORT_WORD` 2775–2779: а, и, в, с, у, о, я, к / но, не, да, он, мы, вы, ты, ни, от, до, на, за, по, из, ко, то, ли, же, бы, ну, ах, ох, ой, эх, уж, ага, так, тот, это, се, об, при, про), **or** a strong short cry matching `STRONG_SHORT_RE = ^[\p{L}]{1,2}[!?…~]{1,4}$` (2482) with **Cyrillic-only** letters (so Japanese "ガッ" SFX is still dropped at ru), **or** a 2-Cyrillic-letter split matching `TWO_LETTER_SPLIT_RE` (2478, e.g. "А — Я").
- **ru branch** (3046–3060): zero Cyrillic → false; Cyrillic/letters < 0.6 → false; needs a Cyrillic word of ≥3 letters (`CYRILLIC_WORD_RE` 2483); otherwise a hyphen-containing row whose de-hyphenated form has a 3+ Cyrillic word survives.
- **en branch** (3061–3065): latin/letters < 0.6 → false; needs `LATIN_WORD_RE` (`[A-Za-z]{3,}`, 2484).
- other languages → `true` (3066).

### `isSiteChromeNoise(text)` (3109–3135) — site chrome
- `CHAPTER_HEADER_RE` (`том(а|у|е)?[\s\d.,-]*глава[\s\d.,-]*`, IGNORE_CASE, 2485) matched and ≤3 letters left after stripping header + `CHROME_CHARS_RE` (`[→←⇐⇒↔—–\-|/\\d\s,.()«»\[\]"']`, 2493) → true.
- `VOLUME_HEAD_RE` (`^том(а|у|е)?\.?\s*\d+`, 2495) + ≥1 digit + ≤6 letters → true ("Том 1").
- `PAGE_COUNTER_RE` (`^\s*[\d.,\s]+\s*(/|из|оф)\s*[\d.,\s]+\s*$`, 2497) → true ("2/89", "стр. 2 из 89").
- No letters at all + any of `→←⇐⇒↔<|/\\·•⭐❤⟩⟨` or ≥2 digits → true.

**Note on the user's examples:** there is no literal list containing `"a"` or `"mgm"` in this file. Single letters/short fragments are handled generically by the rules above (`letters == 0`, `<0.4` letter ratio, 1–2 letter whitelist, 3-letter-word requirement); "interjections" are explicitly *kept* (`ах, ох, ой, эх, ну, ага` in `RUSSIAN_SHORT_WORD`) rather than filtered.

## 3. `isMeaningful` (3071–3101) — acceptance rules for a whole line

```kotlin
fun isMeaningful(text: String, language: String): Boolean         // 3071
```

1. Blank → false (3072).
2. `OcrTextCleaner.isPromotionalText(text)` → false (3073; watermarks/slogans).
3. `!matchesLanguage(text, language)` → false (3074).
4. `isSiteChromeNoise(text)` → false (3078) — headers, volume/age marks, page counters.
5. **Single-symbol explosion removal** (3084–3088): if the alphanumeric content is exactly 1 char and it's an uppercase Cyrillic letter that is **not** in `"АИОУЯЁЕЮЫ"` → false (vignette "В", "Б").
6. **Echo/garbage removal** (3089–3095): if **every** word has ≥3 letters with some letter repeated ≥3 times ("цшшшш", "щщщ") → false. Laughter "хаха/хи-хи" has at most ×2 and survives.
7. Accepted if **any** of (3096–3100): a word with ≥3 letters; **or** (ru only) a word that is a real short Russian word; **or** the whole text is 2..6 chars with ≥2 letters ("Да!", "Ах!", "Нет?").

`matchesLanguage` (3141–3156): `"any"` → true; empty letters → false; ≥60 % of letters in the target alphabet (ru `\u0400..\u04FF`, en, ja, ko, zh; unknown code → true).

## 4. `isDuplicate` (534–556) and history state

```kotlin
@Synchronized private fun isDuplicate(rawText: String): Boolean  // 534
@Synchronized fun clearHistory()                                  // 558
```

State:
- `spokenTexts: ArrayDeque<String>` (528) — normalized (lowercase, letters/digits only) strings.
- `spokenRaws: ArrayDeque<String>` (532) — raw strings, for `stripSpokenPrefix` word matching.
- Both capped at `HISTORY_LIMIT = 600` (2468, 553–554).
- **`spokenLines: ConcurrentHashMap.KeySetView<String>`** (130) — separate "frozen lines" set (this-frame/past-frame already spoken, DONE overlay). Cleared only in `stop()` (1722) and `destroy()`.
- `prevFrameLines: List<String>` (465) — previous frame's texts, fed to `AiAssistant.prepareFrame` as `prevLines` (1086–1093) and reassigned at 1096.
- **`lastFrameLines` does not exist anywhere in the repo** (verified by grep). The engine's equivalent is `prevFrameLines` (465) plus `lastFrameText` (451) / `lastFrameHadText` (446).

Mechanism (yes, fuzzy):
- Normalization `rawText.lowercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }` (536).
- **Guard change:** `if (norm.length < 4) return false` (540) — short *real* words are no longer silenced (comment: "я, и, но, не, да… читаем"). Note this returns early *without* recording the line in history.
- Cheap length pre-filter before trigrams: `if (shorter < CONTAINMENT_RATIO * longer) continue` (548; `CONTAINMENT_RATIO = 0.8f`, 2508) — history grows to 600 lines × 40 bubbles = 24 000 comparisons per frame.
- Then `isSameSpokenLine(old, norm)` (2829–2842): equality → true; if `shorter < 0.8 * longer` → false; `trigramSimilarity(old,new) >= 0.6f` → true; else containment (`old.contains(new)` or reverse).
- If no match, the line is **added to history** (551–552) and trimmed; returns false.
- `trigramSimilarity` (2801–2811): 3-gram sets, no substring allocation (`trigramKey` 2797–2798 packs 3 UTF-16 codes into a Long); ratio = common / total trigrams of `b`.
- Fuzzy history is deliberately **shared across frames** for the whole "conveyor" duration so a slowly scrolled webtoon tail isn't re-read; `clearHistory()` resets it (called from `ReaderActivity` at 1837 on manual "read page" and 1940 on `startAutoReadLoop`, and from `SettingsAdvancedScreen` 230).

Related helper: `stripSpokenPrefix` (586–625) — removes an already-spoken *word* prefix when OCR re-issues the same bubble with a longer tail ("…вперёд!" → "…вперёд! Берегись!"); one "noisy" word skip allowed (604), returns the new tail, or `""` when nothing new is left (which the caller treats as "already spoken", 1312–1314).

## 5. `orderRegions` (2859–2905) and reading order

```kotlin
fun orderRegions(lines: List<Line>, order: String): List<Line>   // 2859 (companion)
```

- `lines.size <= 1` → returned as-is (2860).
- `order` → `ReadingDirection` (2861–2865): `"ltr"` → LTR (left→right), `"vertical"` → VERTICAL (top→bottom), **anything else (incl. `"rtl"`) → RTL** (this is the manga default).
- Rect conversion at `scale = 100_000` (2868–2880); `Rect` fields assigned via properties (mockable-android jar quirk).
- **Column/band handling** (2887–2900): when `order != "vertical"`, lines are first grouped into **horizontal bands** by `groupIntoBands` (2912–2927) — a line joins the current band while its `top` is not below `bandBottom - BAND_TOLERANCE` (`0.02f`, 2929); each band is then sorted **inside itself** with `ReadingOrderSorter.sort(rects, direction)` (2894–2896) and bands are concatenated in top→bottom order. This is what fixes "the narrow bubble in the middle of a panel is read before the wide one at the top".
- If there is ≤1 band, or for `vertical`, the whole set is sorted once with `ReadingOrderSorter.sort(...)` (2902–2904) — recursive-cut sorter: horizontal cut primary (top→bottom), vertical cut RTL/LTR, positional fallback when there's no clean cut.
- Where `order` comes from: `bookReadingOrder(rules)` (633–641) — learned per-book rule `KIND_READING_ORDER` (643–652: `BookKnowledge.readingOrderOf` for the current manga, ignoring `"auto"`) → **else** `OcrRegionRules.readingOrderFor(prefs)` (641; OcrRegionRules.kt:154 → `scanReadingOrder` pref unless "auto", else derived from reader vertical/RTL context).
- Streaming is allowed only for non-RTL: `orderAllowsStreaming(order) = order != "rtl"` (1923) — with RTL the local detector emits regions left-to-right, so on-the-fly speech would read backwards.

A Kotlin `object` (singleton) in package `mihon.data.ocr`. KDoc claims support for "Google Translate, DeepL, and LLM translation gateways", but the implementation is **Google free translate endpoint only** (`translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx...`, line 72).

**Public API:**

| Lines | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 30–57 | `suspend fun translateAll(texts: List<String>, targetLang: String = "ru", sourceLang: String = "auto"): List<String>` | Batch translation in ONE HTTP request |
| 62–102 | `suspend fun translate(text: String, targetLang: String = "ru", sourceLang: String = "auto"): String` | Single-string translation |

- Line 19: `private val SEPARATOR_REGEX = Regex("""\s*@\s*@\s*@\s*""")` — tolerates spaces the translator may insert around `@@@`.
- Batching (lines 39–47): lines are joined with separator `"\n@@@\n"`. If `joined.length > 1500` it recursively splits the list in half and concatenates results. Note: line 45–46 **returns the result of translating both halves** (`return@withContext translateAll(take) + translateAll(drop)`) — correct behavior.
- Split-back safety: `parts.size == texts.size` → use parts (blank part falls back to original `texts[index]` via `ifBlank`, line 52); otherwise per-line fallback with logcat INFO (lines 53–56).
- Failure handling: any exception → original text returned, `logcat(WARN)` (lines 98–101). Blank input → `""` (line 67). Blank result → original text (line 97).
- No interceptors / no user-visible language picker here; language pair is purely caller-supplied strings (BCP-47).

### Where translation is invoked

All call sites (grep `MangaTranslatorService`, 12 matches total):

1. **`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/tts/AutoReadEngine.kt`** (import line 36)
   - Line 1153 (stream mode): `MangaTranslatorService.translateAll(ordered.map { it.text }, target, translateSource)` inside `scope.async { runCatching { … }.getOrElse { ordered.map { it.text } } }`
   - Line 1158 (non-stream): same call, synchronous with `runCatching` fallback.

   - Guard: `if (translate && language != target)` — translation is skipped when frame language equals target.
   - Per-engine mode: `prefs.autoReadModeFor(result.ocrModel).get()` with `"stream"` (background batch translate, speak immediately) / `"bubble"` (default) / `"page"` (lines 1149–1150).
   - Also lines 1295, 1380 mention translation fallback/stream paths when consuming `translations`.

2. **`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/presentation/reader/TranslationCard.kt`** (import line 44)

Result also posted to a system notification (lines 88–89 → `showTranslationNotification`, id 7001, channel `yomihon_translation_channel`, lines 247–278).

3. **`/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/ui/overlay/GameSttManager.kt`** (import line 17)

parts.text:
Excellent — I have a comprehensive map. Now let me plan the implementation of the requested features. The user's list (translating into tasks):

A. **Reader: overlay on/off toggle for user** — "в читалке манги добавь включить и выключить наложение для пользователя". The overlay = the region highlight/bubble overlays drawn over the page (AutoReadHighlight + OcrBubbleVoiceOverlay). Add a toggle (in reader OCR menu / settings). There's already `ocrOverlayCompact`, `ocrPageTextOverlay`... The likely need: a master switch for "наложение" (highlight boxes) — `pref_autoread_overlay_enabled` default true. Where to put: ReaderTopBar OCR dropdown + OcrBubbleSettingsDialog. Overlay components read pref and don't draw when off.

B. **Read every letter even "а" / "мгм" / interjections** — the filters drop them. Add a pref like `ocrKeepInterjections` (default... hmm user says "должна читаться" — so behavior: when enabled, keep short/interjection lines). Default true? The user complains they're currently dropped. Make default true? Existing users had=false... I'd set default true since user demands. Add pref `pref_autoread_read_all_chars` (default true) — when on, bypass `isMeaningful`/short-word filters for lines that contain ANY letters (still drop promos/site chrome? The user says each letter should be read even if just "а" or "мгм" — but promos should still be dropped via cleanOcrGarbage... they specifically complained about ad text before. I'll keep promo stripping and dedup, but pass isMeaningful).

Implementation: in the filter pipeline (AutoReadEngine ~988-1002):
```kotlin
.map { it.copy(text = cleanOcrGarbage(it.text, language)) }
.let { if (readAllChars) it else it.filter { isMeaningful(it.text, language) } }
```
Wait — cleanOcrGarbage itself filters rows internally. For interjections like "а" (single Cyrillic letter) — cleanOcrGarbage early-returns for single word length 3..14; "а" is length 1 → not early-returned; isMeaningfulRow: letters=1 → letters<=2 → ru branch → not in RUSSIAN_SINGLE_WORD? "а" IS in RUSSIAN_SINGLE_WORD (а, и, в, с, у, о, я, к) → kept! So "а" survives in ru. But "мгм" — length 3, letters 3 → isMeaningfulRow: letters<=2 false → ru branch: zero Cyrillic? No, it has Cyrillic; ratio fine; needs CYRILLIC_WORD_RE (≥3 Cyrillic letters) → "мгм" matches [\u0400-\u04FF]{3,} → meaningful! So "мгм" IS meaningful... unless language is en/ja. Hmm. So what's actually being dropped? Maybe the issue is in the reader overall: "даже если и состоит из просто а.. либо мгм" — e.g., "А..." with dots, "Мгм...", "Ха-ха", laughter. E.g. STRONG_SHORT_RE requires [!?…~] after 1-2 letters — "А!" ok. "Мгм." — period not in set... Let me handle: when the read-all-chars pref is on, bypass both isMeaningful and cleanOcrGarbage's row filtering for short lines — pass any non-blank line through (still strip promo/site chrome? The user explicitly wants ad text NOT read though — keep `cleanOcrGarbage` promo strip but skip meaningfulness). I'll add pref `pref_autoread_read_everything` ("Читать всё, включая междометия") default ON, and in pipeline:

```kotlin
val keepAll = prefs.??? // readAllChars
.map { it.copy(text = cleanOcrGarbage(it.text, language)) }
.filter { keepAll ?: isMeaningful(it.text, language) }  // hmm: if keepAll, only need non-blank
```
But careful: `cleanOcrGarbage` may return "" for garbage — filter blank after. And keep isDuplicate + box sanity.

Hmm, but with keepAll on, garbage like "| | > |" (no letters) would be read? "каждая буква должна читаться" — every letter. Lines with zero letters produce TTS noise. Compromise: keepAll keeps any line with ≥1 letter (skip isMeaningful), still dropping zero-letter rows. Good.

C. **Translation toggle + real translation + swap languages arrow** — "добавь кнопку включить выключить перевод страницы например я хочу китайскую манхуа прочесть на русском и чтобы он реально читал её а не выдумывал" — a clear ON/OFF button for page translation + language swap. Existing: `autoReadTranslate()` + `translateTarget()` + `autoReadTranslateSource()`. Need: (1) toggle in reader UI (ReaderTopBar already has "Перевод перед озвучкой" switch + source/target submenus — but user wants a simple toggle button and a swap arrow ⇄). So: add to the OCR dropdown: "Перевод страницы: вкл/выкл" row + "⇄" swap button that swaps autoReadTranslateSource ↔ translateTarget. 

"чтобы он реально читал её а не выдумывал" — ensure translation REALLY translates: currently if `language == target`, translation is skipped. Also for Chinese manhua: `autoReadLanguage` (frame language filter) is ru by default → matchesLanguage requires ≥60% of letters in ru alphabet → Chinese text is NOT ru → lines get DROPPED! That's the "выдумывает" part? No wait — "выдумывал" = makes up. Hmm — for manhua, the local cyrillic OCR reads garbage (Cyrillic letters won't appear in Chinese text; matchesLanguage(text,"ru") fails → all lines dropped → reader falls back to something). Actually the OCR engine for Chinese would be GLENS or ZEN_FREE/GOOGLE with vision — those transcribe Chinese properly. Then `language` pref = "ru" → matchesLanguage requires ≥60% Cyrillic → all Chinese lines dropped! So auto-read of manhua DOESN'T WORK with default settings. Fix: the frame-language filter should accept "any", or derive from OCR engine capability. Better: when autoReadTranslate is on and source != target, don't filter by matchesLanguage? Hmm. Practical fix:
- Change default `autoReadLanguage` to "any"? That changes behavior for everyone... The user explicitly wants manhua: make `matchesLanguage` check skipped when `keepAll`/readAllChars is on? My "read everything" toggle would fix it. Also translation target logic: `if (translate && language != target)` — for Chinese text, language="ru" ≠ target="ru" is false → no translation! So Chinese gets skipped anyway.

Let me restructure the language gating for robustness:
- `language` (frame filter): if the new pref "readAllChars" is on → skip matchesLanguage entirely (accept any letters).
- Translation gate: `translate && (language != target)` — replace with: translation active when `prefs.autoReadTranslate()` AND (translateSource != target or language != target)... Actually simplest correct: translate whenever translate toggle is on and the source lang != target lang, where source = autoReadTranslateSource().ifBlank{"auto"}. If source == "auto", we can't know; then translate unless language == target... but language is the RU filter — wrong signal for foreign text. Change: when language filter is "any" (or readAllChars), treat language as unknown → translate if toggle on. So: `val shouldTranslate = translate && (translateSource != target)` && (language == "any" || language != target || readAllChars). Hmm let me simplify: `shouldTranslate = translate && translateSource != target` — if user set source "auto" and target "ru" → auto != ru → translate. If source ru == target ru → skip. That's clean and fixes manhua: source auto (default) → translate to ru. And Chinese text read by a vision engine → translated. 

But also the actual OCR must produce the Chinese text. That's engine selection (GLENS with glensLanguage setting, or ZEN_FREE/GOOGLE). The user says "чтобы он реально читал её а не выдумывал" — maybe with cyrillic engine on a manhua, OCR produces NOTHING, so the engine reads page as empty... "выдумывает" might refer to it reading garbage. Ensure that when the frame language filter doesn't match, we don't drop everything silently — log to AiConsole/OcrHistoryStore. I'll add: if all lines dropped due to language mismatch → history note "реплики отсеяны фильтром языка" so user knows.

D. **Swap languages arrow** — same row: "⇄ Обменять языки" button in the OCR dropdown swapping prefs.

E. **Narrow pages read worse; words cut off; duplicate "лесенки" over marked frames** — scan completeness: OCR_SCAN_MAX_EDGE=1600 downscale; narrow (portrait) pages → image height large. Small text may be lost. Fix approach: adaptive upscaling for scan when the image is small? Or increase OCR_SCAN_MAX_EDGE? The user: "широкую страницу он читает идеально даже самый маленький текст а когда страница не широкая... слова недоговаривает либо не всегда сканирует все слова" — wide page (landscape?) reads perfectly even tiny text; narrow page (portrait/double-page?) — words truncated, not all words scanned. Hmm, actually for manga: wide page = webtoon-ish? Or the manga page vs the page in two-page spread? Likely: full-screen-wide pages scan great; tall/portrait pages scan poorly. Possibly related to: 1) the frame capture of webtoon vs pager — pager page fully visible; 2) scan downscale to 1600px edge — for a portrait manga page 1654x2339 → scaled to 1600x2263 fine. For webtoon strip very tall, scaled edge 1600 → lots of width loss. Hmm.

Actually "широкую страницу" for the browser earlier: 720×1098 wide read perfect. For reader: maybe wide pager pages (landscape images displayed)? vs a portrait image rendered in a portrait screen where the image is letterboxed?

I think the concrete change: adaptive scan resolution based on image size relative to screen — e.g., allow up to 2400 edge for small pages (portrait), and add a 1.5× upscale when the detected text height is small... complex. Simpler robust approach used by many OCR pipelines: **upscale the frame 1.5× when its long edge < 1080** (small portrait page → enlarge for detector). And **tile-scan large pages**: if scaled image area is much smaller than source... hmm.

Wait, maybe reread: "широкую страницу он читает идеально даже самый маленький текст а когда страница не широкая а как положено он слова недоговаривает" — wide page reads perfectly, even the smallest text; when the page is NOT wide (as it should be — portrait manga page), it truncates words. This sounds like: on the wide (landscape) page the OCR pipeline works; on the normal portrait page the pipeline truncates. What could differ? In the reader, PagerViewer pages: portrait image fits height with margin? Or "как положено" = correct aspect. Possibly the scan uses downscaled bitmap with width ~... For a portrait manga page 2058x2936 displayed on 1080x1920 screen, the frame bitmap has aspect NOT matching page; conversion of boxes via crop geometry could clip? Or `mergeBubbleLines` merging wrongly cutting text?

Also "делает ненужные лесенки дубликаты поверх отмеченных рамок" — duplicate boxes drawn as "ladder" over the marked regions: i.e., extra regions from streaming + main loop both drawn (frameRegions duplicated). In streaming mode, speakStreamingRegion appends regions; then main loop republishes — possibly both old and new boxes present. Or `markSpokenInFrame` and re-publish mismatch. "Лесинки" = staircases: boxes drawn at slightly offset positions for the same text (frame box vs page box conversion inconsistency → two boxes, one for CURRENT, one for DONE of the same line). This might be due to streaming pass boxes (frame-normalized) vs pageBox (page-normalized) mismatch — `speakStreamingRegion` appends FrameRegion WITHOUT pageBox mapping? Line 1850-1855 appends `FrameRegion(..., region.boundingBox, ...)` — hmm need to check if it maps via pageBox. If streaming appends raw frame boxes and main loop publishes pageBox-mapped boxes, the same text appears twice at different positions → "лесенки"! That's likely the bug. Fix: map via pageBox in streaming too.

F. **Frames not erased when returning to a page manually** — "рамки при возврате на страницу вручную не стираются" — stale highlight boxes remain when manually navigating back to a page. Cause: `spokenLines` never cleared on page change; `_frameRegions` cleared only in readFrame finally. When user manually goes back to a page, the last frame's regions stay drawn. Fix: in ReaderActivity page-change handler → `autoReadEngine.clearHighlights()` or on manual page change, clear `_frameRegions`/`_currentRegion`/`spokenLines`. Add `fun clearVisuals()` to engine; call on page change (viewer page change callback) and stop().

G. **Delete screenshot removes it everywhere** — currently deletes internal file only (clear() deletes internal copies; gallery copies stay). User wants delete to remove it COMPLETELY ("удаляю его насовсем, а не только в приложении" — deletes it entirely, not just in the app). So: add single-entry delete that removes the internal JPEG AND the MediaStore gallery copy if published, AND add a per-entry delete button, AND "clear all" should also remove gallery copies? The dialog text says only in-app copies deleted; user wants everything gone. Implement:
- `OcrScreenshotEntry` gains `galleryUri: String?` — record MediaStore uri on publish.
- `remove(id)` / `removeEntries(ids)` in buffer: delete internal file + MediaStore row (if uri recorded) → truly removes.

The gate `translate && language != target` appears three times (1155, 1167, 1173). I'll introduce a local `val shouldTranslate = translate && translateSource != target` — this fixes manhua: with source "auto" and target "ru", old gate compared language ("ru" default) == target → false → no translation. New gate: source != target → translate.

Edge: if source == target (user set ru→ru), skip translation. If language == target AND source is "auto"? E.g., reading Japanese manga with autoReadLanguage="ja", translate on, source auto, target ru → old: ja != ru → translate (worked). New: auto != ru → translate (works). Reading ru book: language ru, source auto, target ru → old: no translate. New: auto != ru → translate ru→ru! Google returns the same text — harmless but wasteful HTTP. Guard: if translateSource == "auto", only translate when the frame language differs from target (or is "any"/unknown). Combine:

```kotlin
val shouldTranslate = translate && when (translateSource) {
    "auto" -> language != target && language != "any"  // ru→ru не переводим; any/иностранный — переводим
    else -> translateSource != target
}
```
Wait for manhua with readEverything: language is whatever user set (default ru). Manhua text is Chinese → language filter is now bypassed by readEverything, so `language == "ru"` while text is Chinese → shouldTranslate false → no translation. Damn.

Better: shouldTranslate should consider the ACTUAL text language. Use the frame's detected dominant language: compute from `ordered` lines' letters: dominant script. If text is mostly CJK and target is ru → translate. Let me implement a small helper: `dominantScript(lines)` returning "zh"/"ja"/"ko"/"ru"/"en"/"" and decide:

```kotlin
val shouldTranslate = translate && run {
    val dom = dominantLanguage(ordered.map { it.text })
    when (translateSource) {
        "auto" -> dom.isNotBlank() && dom != target && !(dom.isBlank())
        else -> translateSource != target
    }
}
```

Simpler robust: 
- effectiveSrc = if (translateSource != "auto") translateSource else dominantLanguage(texts) (may be "")
- translate if translate && effectiveSrc.isNotBlank() && effectiveSrc != target

dominantLanguage: count chars by script: Cyrillic (0400-04FF), Latin (0041-005A,0061-007A), Kana (3040-30FF), Hangul (AC00-D7AF), Han (4E00-9FFF). Return the top script's code, "" if no letters. "ja" = kana present or han+kana. Let me write:

```kotlin
private fun dominantLanguage(texts: List<String>): String {
    var cyr = 0; var lat = 0; var kana = 0; var hangul = 0; var han = 0
    for (t in texts) for (ch in t) {
        when {
            ch in '\u0400'..'\u04FF' -> cyr++
            ch in '\u0041'..'\u005A' || ch in '\u0061'..'\u007A' -> lat++
            ch in '\u3040'..'\u30FF' || ch in '\u31F0'..'\u31FF' -> kana++
            ch in '\uAC00'..'\uD7AF' -> hangul++
            ch in '\u4E00'..'\u9FFF' -> han++
        }
    }
    val top = maxOf(cyr, lat, kana, hangul, han)
    if (top == 0) return ""
    return when (top) {
        cyr -> "ru"; lat -> "en"; kana -> "ja"; hangul -> "ko"; else -> "zh"
    }
}
```

```kotlin
/** Дубли рамок: одна и та же реплика двумя боксами (поток + основной проход). */
private fun dropOverlappingDuplicates(lines: List<Line>): List<Line> {
    if (lines.size < 2) return lines
    val kept = ArrayList<Line>(lines.size)
    for (line in lines) {
        val key = lineKey(line.text)
        val box = line.boundingBox
        val dup = kept.any { k ->
            lineKey(k.text) == key &&
                overlapRatio(box, k.boundingBox) > 0.25f
        }
        if (!dup) kept += line
    }
    return kept
}

private fun overlapRatio(a: OcrBoundingBox, b: OcrBoundingBox): Float {
    val iw = (min(a.right, b.right) - max(a.left, b.left)).coerceAtLeast(0f)
    val ih = (min(a.bottom, b.bottom) - max(a.top, b.top)).coerceAtLeast(0f)
    val inter = iw * ih
    if (inter <= 0f) return 0f
    val union = (a.right - a.left) * (a.bottom - a.top) + (b.right - b.left) * (b.bottom - b.top) - inter
    return if (union <= 0f) 0f else inter / union
}
```

Also I notice the KDoc for `orderRegions` lost its `*/` alignment — line 2950 has `*` at wrong indent — cosmetic, fine (was like that before? The original had "     *" because my earlier read showed lines 2951+ with extra spaces — that's pre-existing from the original file. Fine.)

Now implement column-aware ordering. The user's complaint: manga read LTR at top but RTL at bottom (inconsistent), columns not split when different widths, zigzag between columns. Desired: text in each column read within its column; columns ordered by reading direction; no zigzag between columns (only within a column, top→bottom).

Plan: rewrite `orderRegions` for non-vertical orders to:
1. Build columns: sort lines by X; cluster into columns where X-intervals overlap enough (e.g., intersection over min-width >= 0.3, or center distance < 0.12). A column = a set of lines whose X ranges overlap the column's X range.
2. Order columns: RTL → rightmost first; LTR → leftmost first.
3. Within a column: order by Y (top→bottom), with band grouping for side-by-side in same column (narrow text side by side within the column) — use band grouping + ReadingOrderSorter horizontal.

Fallback: if only one column (all overlapping) → current band logic.

But wait — a manga page has rows of bubbles: bubble A (top row), B (top row), C (middle row)... Each row has bubbles at different X. Column clustering would group bubbles across rows that share X ranges — e.g., A and C share X, B doesn't → columns [A,C], [B] → order RTL: column with B (rightmost) first → B, then A, then C — WRONG (LTR-ish rows broken).

Hmm! So pure columns is wrong for manga rows. The user says: "он всега читает текст слева направо только в верху а внизу ленится и читает справо на лево" — at the TOP of the page it reads left-to-right always, at the BOTTOM it's lazy and reads right-to-left. And "не делит их по колонкам с текстом особенно когда одна больше вторая уже а третья в полэкрана" — "it doesn't split them into text columns, especially when one [column] is bigger, the second narrower, and the third half-screen" — this describes WEBTOON/manhwa vertical columns of text. So the complaint is about VERTICAL scrolling content (webtoon/manhua) where text blocks are columns of different widths, and the reader zigzags between them instead of finishing one column then moving to the next.

And "также когда читать справо налево" — the same applies when reading RTL: it should go column by column right-to-left.

So the desired logic: for RTL and LTR (and probably vertical), read COLUMN by column: within a column, top→bottom (with in-column left/right per direction for side-by-side in the same column); columns ordered per direction (RTL: right→left).

But classical manga rows would break as I showed... unless the column detection uses CONNECTED X-overlap with tolerance and manga rows of left/right bubbles end up in different columns. Hmm — in manga, row 1: bubble right (X 0.6-0.9), bubble left (X 0.1-0.4) — no overlap → two columns: [right-bubble-row1, right-bubble-row2...], [left-bubble-row1, left-bubble-row2...]. Reading RTL reads all right-column bubbles top→bottom, then left column top→bottom. But the CORRECT manga order is row1-right, row1-left, row2-right, row2-left! Reading column-by-column gives: row1-right, row2-right, row1-left, row2-left — WRONG for manga.

So column-major is correct only for WEBTOON-style columns of continuous text (manhwa), and row-major is correct for manga rows. How to distinguish? Heuristic: if the layout is mostly ROWS (bubbles at similar Y ranges, few per row, X gaps) → row-major. If columns contain multiple bubbles stacked vertically with similar X and the page has ≥3 columns of clearly different widths → column-major.

Alternative robust approach: keep row-major band grouping (top→bottom), but ACROSS bands use per-band direction ordering (already exists!) — the user's bug: "вверху слева-направо, внизу справа-налево" suggests direction flips between bands: that happens when `bands.size == 1` (single band) → whole set sorted with ReadingOrderSorter RTL — some parts of the page read RTL, and when there are multiple bands each band sorted RTL — consistent... The complaint says TOP read LTR (wrong for manga default RTL). Hmm, maybe their book's order is ltr? Or their OCR bubbles at top have equal tops and get grouped weirdly.

Honestly, the most valuable improvement per user text: column-aware ordering when columns are detected. And the user explicitly describes the scene: "одна больше вторая уже а третья в полэкрана" = one column wider, second narrower, third half-screen → that's classic manhua/webtoon layout of text blocks. Their reading mode for manhua is probably "vertical" order (from content preset: manhwa→vertical). In vertical mode the whole set goes to `ReadingOrderSorter.sort` single pass (no bands) — and ReadingOrderSorter does horizontal cuts primary (top→bottom) then vertical cut... For webtoon columns it might zigzag.

Let me look at ReadingOrderSorter to understand its behavior.

      * v1.9.137 — ПЕЙСИНГ С АВТОЧТЕНИЕМ: пока кадр сканируется/распознаётся/
      * озвучивается ([autoReadFrameBusy]), прокрутка СТОИТ — на большой скорости
      * глаза больше не убегают от голоса. А сама авточтение при старте сама
      * включает эту кнопку (см. startAutoReadLoop), а не свои «прыжки».
      */
     @Volatile
     private var autoReadFrameBusy = false
 
     /** Автопрокрутку включила АВТОЧТЕНИЕ (снять при его остановке). */
     @Volatile
     private var autoscrollAutoEnabled = false
 
     /** Последняя выбранная скорость — чтобы авто-включение шло с той же. */
     private var lastAutoscrollSpeed = 2f
 
     private fun toggleAutoscroll(active: Boolean, speed: Float) {
         autoscrollJob?.cancel()
         autoscrollJob = null
         if (active) lastAutoscrollSpeed = speed
         if (!active) return
         // repeatOnLifecycle, а не просто lifecycleScope: тот живёт до
         // onDestroy, поэтому после сворачивания приложения 60-Гц scrollBy
         // продолжал крутиться в фоне и есть всю батарею, пока читатель в
         // другом приложении. Цикл теперь живёт только в STARTED.
         autoscrollJob = lifecycleScope.launch {
             repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                 while (true) {
                     when (val viewer = viewModel.state.value.viewer) {
                         is eu.kanade.tachiyomi.ui.reader.viewer.webtoon.WebtoonViewer -> {
                             // Пейсинг: кадр авточтения занят (скан/OCR/речь) —
                             // прокрутка ЗАМЕДЛЯЕТСЯ до трети скорости (v1.9.138:
                             // не полный стоп — лента чуть ползёт, глаз не бежит
                             // впереди голоса, но и картинка не застывает).
                             if (autoReadActive && autoReadFrameBusy) {
                                 val slow = (speed / 3f).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
                                 viewer.recycler.scrollBy(0, slow)
                                 kotlinx.coroutines.delay(24)
                             } else {
                                 // ~60 Гц; скорость 1..10 → 1..10 px за кадр
                                 viewer.recycler.scrollBy(0, speed.toInt().coerceAtLeast(1))
                                 kotlinx.coroutines.delay(16)
                             }
                         }
                         is eu.kanade.tachiyomi.ui.reader.viewer.pager.PagerViewer -> {
                             // Скорость 1..10 → пауза 11..2 сек на страницу
                             kotlinx.coroutines.delay((12_000L - speed.toLong() * 1_000L).coerceAtLeast(2_000L))
                             viewer.moveToNext()
                         }
                         else -> kotlinx.coroutines.delay(250)
                     }
                 }
             }
         }
     }

     /**
      * Called when the activity is created. Initializes the presenter and configuration.
      */
     override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
         registerSecureActivity(this)
         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
             overrideActivityTransition(
                 OVERRIDE_TRANSITION_OPEN,
                 R.anim.shared_axis_x_push_enter,
                 R.anim.shared_axis_x_push_exit,
             )
         } else {
             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
             overridePendingTransition(R.anim.shared_axis_x_push_enter, R.anim.shared_axis_x_push_exit)
         }
 
         enableEdgeToEdge()
         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
             window.isNavigationBarContrastEnforced = false
         }
         windowInsetsController.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
 
         super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
 
         binding = ReaderActivityBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
         setContentView(binding.root)
         registerReaderAiActions()
         // v1.9.40: long-press на странице читалки = выбор области скана (как в вебе).
         // v1.9.46: если включено авто-сканирование — удержание сразу выделяет,
         // распознаёт и озвучивает область вокруг точки касания (autoclick с
         // удержанием), запоминая её; иначе — обычный ручной выбор области.
         binding.root.setOnLongClickListener {
             val wantAuto = uy.kohesive.injekt.Injekt.get<mihon.domain.ocr.service.OcrPreferences>()
                 .autoReadAutoStart().get()
             if (wantAuto) {
                 val ev = lastTouch
                 if (ev == null) {
                     runCatching { enterOcrMode() }
                     return@setOnLongClickListener true
                 }
                 val loc = IntArray(2)
                 binding.root.getLocationOnScreen(loc)
                 val local = android.graphics.PointF(ev.rawX - loc[0], ev.rawY - loc[1])
                 captureAndSpeakRegion(holdRegionAround(local))
                 true
             } else {
                 runCatching { enterOcrMode() }
                 true
             }
         }
         binding.setComposeOverlay()
 
         if (viewModel.needsInit()) {
             val manga = intent.extras?.getLong("manga", -1) ?: -1L
             val chapter = intent.extras?.getLong("chapter", -1) ?: -1L
             if (manga == -1L || chapter == -1L) {
                 finish()
                 return
             }
             NotificationReceiver.dismissNotification(this, manga.hashCode(), Notifications.ID_NEW_CHAPTERS)
 
             lifecycleScope.launchNonCancellable {
                 val initResult = viewModel.init(manga, chapter)
                 if (!initResult.getOrDefault(false)) {
                     val exception = initResult.exceptionOrNull() ?: IllegalStateException("Unknown err")
                     withUIContext {
                         setInitialChapterError(exception)
                     }
                 }
             }
         }
 
         // Прогрев OCR: инициализация модели не должна попадать в тайминг
         // первого ручного сканирования.
         viewModel.warmupOcr()
 
         config = ReaderConfig()
         setMenuVisibility(viewModel.state.value.menuVisible)
 
         // Finish when incognito mode is disabled
         preferences.incognitoMode.changes()
             .drop(1)
             .onEach { if (!it) finish() }
             .launchIn(lifecycleScope)
 
         viewModel.state
             .map { it.isLoadingAdjacentChapter }
             .distinctUntilChanged()
             .onEach(::setProgressDialog)
             .launchIn(lifecycleScope)
 
         viewModel.state
             .map { it.manga }
             .distinctUntilChanged()
             .filterNotNull()
             .onEach { updateViewer() }
             .launchIn(lifecycleScope)
 
         viewModel.state
             .map { it.viewerChapters }
             .distinctUntilChanged()
             .filterNotNull()
             .onEach(::setChapters)
             .launchIn(lifecycleScope)
 
         viewModel.eventFlow
             .onEach { event ->
                 when (event) {
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.ReloadViewerChapters -> {
                         viewModel.state.value.viewerChapters?.let(::setChapters)
                     }
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.PageChanged -> {
                         displayRefreshHost.flash()
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.SetOrientation -> {
                         setOrientation(event.orientation)
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.SavedImage -> {
                         onSaveImageResult(event.result)
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.ShareImage -> {
                         onShareImageResult(event.uri, event.page)
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.CopyImage -> {
                         onCopyImageResult(event.uri)
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.SetCoverResult -> {
                         onSetAsCoverResult(event.result)
                     }
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.OcrNoTextFound -> {
                         clearActiveOcrOverlaySession()
                         toast(MR.strings.no_results_found)
                     }
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.OcrResultMarked -> {
                         // Пометка видна и во вкладке «Скриншоты», и во всплывающем
                         // индикаторе угла — сообщаем, что результат не пропал.
                         toast("Распознанное сохранено в «Скриншоты»")
                     }
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.OcrMemoryError -> {
                         clearActiveOcrOverlaySession()
                         toast(MR.strings.ocr_memory_error)
                     }
                     ReaderViewModel.Event.OcrInitializationError -> {
                         clearActiveOcrOverlaySession()
                         toast(MR.strings.ocr_initialization_error)
                     }
                     is ReaderViewModel.Event.OcrError -> {
                         clearActiveOcrOverlaySession()
                         // Показываем реальную причину (если есть), а не глухое
                         // «Unknown OCR Error Occurred». Это помогает сообщить,
                         // что именно упало в оффлайн-сканировании.
                         val detail = event.message?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                         if (detail != null) {
                             logcat(LogPriority.ERROR) { "OCR error surfaced to UI: $detail" }
                             toast("Ошибка OCR: $detail")
                         } else {
                             toast(MR.strings.error_unknown)
                         }
                     }
                 }
             }
             .launchIn(lifecycleScope)
     }

         // Авто-чтение при открытии главы (опция «Автостарт чтения») и сценарий

         // ориентации и при перелистывании. Со старой проверкой `!autoReadActive`

         val autoStartChapter by remember { mutableStateOf(
             uy.kohesive.injekt.Injekt.get<mihon.domain.ocr.service.OcrPreferences>().autoReadAutoStart().get() ||
                 intent.getBooleanExtra("autoread_start", false),
         ) }
         androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(state.currentChapter?.chapter?.id, state.viewer) {
             val chapterId = state.currentChapter?.chapter?.id ?: return@LaunchedEffect
             if (!autoStartChapter || state.viewer == null) return@LaunchedEffect
             if (!autoReadStartedChapters.add(chapterId)) return@LaunchedEffect
             startAutoReadLoop()
         }
 
+        // Ручная смена страницы: наложение прошлого кадра (рамки реплик,
+        // номера, значки) не должно оставаться висеть на новой странице.
+        // Во время автоцикла не трогаем — там рамки обновляет сам кадр.
+        var lastVisualPage by remember { mutableStateOf(state.currentPage) }
+        androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(state.currentPage) {
+            if (autoReadActive || autoReadLoop != null) {

+            }
+            if (state.currentPage != lastVisualPage) {
+                lastVisualPage = state.currentPage
+                autoReadEngine.clearVisuals()
+            }

         androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(state.currentChapter?.chapter?.id) {
             val chapter = state.currentChapter?.chapter ?: return@LaunchedEffect
             val manga = viewModel.manga ?: return@LaunchedEffect
             if (!autoLookedUpChapters.add(chapter.id)) return@LaunchedEffect

                 if (summary != null) withUIContext { toast(summary.lineSequence().first()) }
             } finally {

         Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
             if (!state.menuVisible && showPageNumber) {

                     currentPage = state.currentPage,

                         .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)

             // ===== Индикатор скриншота в правом верхнем углу =====
             // Пульсирующая точка + количество распознанных регионов.

                             .align(Alignment.TopEnd)

                             .background(

                                     .copy(alpha = 0.85f * pulseAlpha),
                                 shape = androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),

                             .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp),

             // поверх страницы одним касанием. При открытом меню её нет: там
             // верх экрана занят панелями.
             run {
                 val screenshotEntries by mihon.data.ocr.OcrScreenshotBuffer.entries.collectAsState()
                 val marksEnabled by OcrPageMarksSettings.changes().collectAsState(
                     initial = OcrPageMarksSettings.isEnabled(),
                 )
                 val marksChapterId = state.currentChapter?.chapter?.id

                         .forPage(marksChapterId, marksPageIndex)

                 // смены кадра.
                 val lastScreenshot by mihon.data.ocr.OcrScreenshotBuffer.lastEntry.collectAsState()
                 LaunchedEffect(lastScreenshot?.id) {
                     if (lastScreenshot != null) invalidateReaderViews()
                 }
                 if (marksAvailable && !state.menuVisible) {
                     androidx.compose.material3.Surface(
                         modifier = Modifier
                             .align(Alignment.TopEnd)
                             .padding(top = 80.dp, end = 12.dp)

                             textDecoration = if (marksEnabled) {
                                 null
                             } else {
                                 androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextDecoration.LineThrough
                             },
                         )
                     }
                 }
             }
 
             ContentOverlay(state = state)
         }

     /**
      * Called when the activity is destroyed. Cleans up the viewer, configuration and any view.
      */
     override fun onDestroy() {
         stopAutoReadLoop()
         // Движок держит собственный CoroutineScope: без destroy фоновый OCR
         // дотягивался до конца уже после ухода с экрана.
         autoReadEngineOrNull?.destroy()
         super.onDestroy()
         autoscrollJob?.cancel()
         viewModel.state.value.viewer?.destroy()
         config = null
         menuToggleToast?.cancel()
         readingModeToast?.cancel()
         eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.ReaderAiActions.unregisterAll(READER_ACTION_PREFIX)
     }
 
     override fun onPause() {
         // Сворачивание/уход с экрана — голос не должен продолжать звучать.
         // Запоминаем, что авточтение было включено САМИМ читателем: после
         // возврата его надо продолжить. Раньше оно глухлось навсегда, а
         // LaunchedEffect автостарта не перезапускался — ключи (глава, вьювер)
         // не менялись, поэтому опция «Автостарт чтения» работала один раз.
         resumeAutoReadOnResume = autoReadActive
         stopAutoReadLoop()
         lifecycleScope.launchNonCancellable {
             viewModel.updateHistory()
         }
         super.onPause()
     }
 
     /**

      * Helps with rotations.

         super.onResume()
         viewModel.restartReadTimer()
         setMenuVisibility(viewModel.state.value.menuVisible)
         if (resumeAutoReadOnResume) {
             resumeAutoReadOnResume = false
             if (viewModel.state.value.viewer != null) {
                 startAutoReadLoop()
             }
         }
     }

     override fun onKeyUp(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent?): Boolean {
         if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_N) {
             loadNextChapter()
             return true
         } else if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_P) {
             loadPreviousChapter()
             return true
         }
         return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event)
     }
 
     /**
      * Dispatches a key event. If the viewer doesn't handle it, call the default implementation.
      */
     override fun dispatchKeyEvent(event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
         val handled = viewModel.state.value.viewer?.handleKeyEvent(event) ?: false
         return handled || super.dispatchKeyEvent(event)
     }
 
     /**
      * Dispatches a generic motion event. If the viewer doesn't handle it, call the default
      * implementation.
      */
     override fun dispatchGenericMotionEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
         val handled = viewModel.state.value.viewer?.handleGenericMotionEvent(event) ?: false
         return handled || super.dispatchGenericMotionEvent(event)
     }
 
     override fun dispatchTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
         lastTouch = LastTouch(rawX = ev.rawX, rawY = ev.rawY, actionMasked = ev.actionMasked)
 
         if (::binding.isInitialized && viewModel.state.value.ocrSelectionMode) {
             val loc = IntArray(2)
             binding.root.getLocationOnScreen(loc)
             val x = ev.rawX - loc[0]
             val y = ev.rawY - loc[1]
 
             when (ev.actionMasked) {
                 MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                     isTapExitEnabled = true
                     ocrDragStart = Offset(x, y)
                     ocrDragEnd = Offset(x, y)
                 }
                 MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                     if (ocrDragStart == null) {
                         ocrDragStart = Offset(x, y)
                     }
                     ocrDragEnd = Offset(x, y)
                 }
                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                     val start = ocrDragStart
                     val end = ocrDragEnd ?: Offset(x, y)
                     if (start != null) {
                         val left = min(start.x, end.x)
                         val top = min(start.y, end.y)
                         val right = max(start.x, end.x)
                         val bottom = max(start.y, end.y)
 
                         if (abs(right - left) > 20 && abs(bottom - top) > 20) {
                             handleSelectedRegion(
                                 rect = android.graphics.RectF(left, top, right, bottom),
                             )
                             resetOcrDrag()
                             return true
                         } else if (isTapExitEnabled) {
                             exitOcrMode()
                         }
                     }
                     resetOcrDrag()
                 }
                 MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                     resetOcrDrag()
                     exitOcrMode()
                 }
             }
 
             return true
         }
         return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev)
     }

     /**
      * Called from the presenter when a manga is ready. Used to instantiate the appropriate viewer.
      */
     private fun updateViewer() {
         val prevViewer = viewModel.state.value.viewer
         val newViewer = ReadingMode.toViewer(viewModel.getMangaReadingMode(), this)
 
         if (window.sharedElementEnterTransition is MaterialContainerTransform) {
             // Wait until transition is complete to avoid crash on API 26
             window.sharedElementEnterTransition.doOnEnd {
                 setOrientation(viewModel.getMangaOrientation())
             }
         } else {
             setOrientation(viewModel.getMangaOrientation())
         }
 
         // Destroy previous viewer if there was one
         if (prevViewer != null) {
             prevViewer.destroy()
             binding.viewerContainer.removeAllViews()
         }
         viewModel.onViewerLoaded(newViewer)
         updateViewerInset(readerPreferences.fullscreen.get(), readerPreferences.drawUnderCutout.get())
         binding.viewerContainer.addView(newViewer.getView())
 
         if (readerPreferences.showReadingMode.get()) {
             showReadingModeToast(viewModel.getMangaReadingMode())
         }
 
         loadingIndicator = ReaderProgressIndicator(this)
         binding.readerContainer.addView(loadingIndicator)
 
         startPostponedEnterTransition()
     }

     fun onPageSelected(page: ReaderPage) {

         if (
             chapterId != null &&
             activeOcrOverlaySession?.selection?.page?.let {
                 it.chapterId != chapterId || it.pageIndex != page.index
             } == true
         ) {
             dismissActiveOcrOverlaySession()
         }
         // Страница стала активной — прочитанные позади страницы автоматически
         // освобождаются из кеша (префетч всей главы не раздувает хранилище).
         pruneReadPagesFromCache(page)
         viewModel.onPageSelected(page)
     }
 
     /**
      * Автоочистка кеша прочитанных страниц: онлайн-префетч подтягивает ВСЮ
      * главу в кеш, поэтому страницы, которые пользователь уже пролистал,
      * удаляем сами после их прочтения. Ближайшую позади страницу сохраняем —
      * на случай возврата на шаг назад.
      */
     private fun pruneReadPagesFromCache(currentPage: ReaderPage) {
         val pages = currentPage.chapter.pages ?: return
         if (currentPage.index <= 1) return
         val chapterCache = uy.kohesive.injekt.Injekt.get<ChapterCache>()
         for (i in 0 until currentPage.index - 1) {
             val imageUrl = pages[i].imageUrl ?: continue
             runCatching {
                 if (chapterCache.isImageInCache(imageUrl)) {
                     chapterCache.removeImageFromCache(imageUrl)
                 }
             }
         }
     }

      * actions to perform is shown.

     fun onPageLongTap(page: ReaderPage) {

     }

     ) {
